"The Launch" is a song by Dutch disc jockey DJ Jean.
It was written by Addy van der Zwan, Jan Engelaar, Jan Voermans, and Koen Groeneveld, with production handled by DJ Jean and Klubbheads (Addy van der Zwan and Koen Groeneveld).
Vocals are performed by Natasja Morales.
